description: This file is a shell script containing a series of test cases for verifying the behavior of 'git apply' commands under various conditions, including applying patches, handling empty patches, using --allow-empty, --index, and testing with unusual filenames.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with a given description.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup commands to run after the test.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that the given command fails.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Checks that a specified file is empty.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Checks that a specified path does not exist.
